name: Button
description: The control for starting an action, like saving, submitting or opening something. It comes in a few weights, from a strong primary button to quieter ones for secondary actions, and as a round floating action button for the main action of a phone screen.

classes.ayy-button: Root. Alone it is the primary button.
classes.ayy-button--secondary: Quiet filled button for secondary actions.
classes.ayy-button--outline: Bordered, transparent. Neutral alternative to secondary.
classes.ayy-button--ghost: No border or fill until hover. Toolbars, icon buttons.
classes.ayy-button--ring: Showcase call to action: quiet fill inside a gradient ring that spins on keyboard focus and mouse hover (not after a tap). For marketing and portfolio pages; one per view.
classes.ayy-button--xs: Extra small: a step under sm (--ayy-size-control-xs: 24px compact, 28 comfortable, 36 touch), sm text a pixel smaller, 14px icon, 4px gap. For a table cell or a tag-like action.
classes.ayy-button--xl: Extra large: a step over lg (--ayy-size-control-lg plus 8px: 44px compact, 52 comfortable, 56 touch), lg text a pixel larger, --ayy-size-icon-lg (24px) icon. For a hero call to action.
classes.ayy-button--sm: Small control step: --ayy-size-control-sm tall (28px compact, 32 comfortable, 40 touch), --ayy-control-text-sm, --ayy-size-icon-sm (16px) icon, 6px gap.
classes.ayy-button--lg: Large control step: --ayy-size-control-lg tall (40px compact, 48 comfortable, 52 touch), --ayy-control-text-lg, --ayy-size-icon-md (20px) icon, 8px gap. Matches large App shell links.
classes.ayy-button--icon: Square at the md control height (32px compact, 40 comfortable, 44 touch), for a single 16px icon.
classes.ayy-button--icon-sm: Square at the sm control height (28px compact, 32 comfortable, 40 touch), for a single 16px icon.
classes.ayy-button--icon-xs: Square at the xs height (24px compact, 28 comfortable, 36 touch), for a single 14px icon.
classes.ayy-button--icon-xl: Square at the xl height (44px compact, 52 comfortable, 56 touch), for a single 24px icon.
classes.ayy-button--icon-lg: Square at the lg control height (40px compact, 48 comfortable, 52 touch), for a single 20px icon beside a large button.
classes.ayy-button--block: Fills its container's width: a card footer, a phone form, a dialog's only action.
classes.ayy-button--start: Icon and label sit at the inline start of a wide button, laid out like an App shell row of the same size: the icon is centred in a square as wide as the button is high, so a sm, md or lg button lines up with a sm, md or lg menu item. Use with block.
classes.ayy-button--end: Icon and label sit at the inline end of a wide button, with the same edge spacing as --start (mirrored). Use with block. Centered is the default, no class.
classes.ayy-button-split: Group joining a main action .ayy-button and a trailing icon .ayy-button (opening a menu) into a single split button with a shared seam.
classes.ayy-button-split--block: Full-width split button: the main action stretches and the menu trigger stays square.
classes.ayy-fab: Floating action button: a <button> (or <a>) with an icon and an aria-label: primary fill, a lifted shadow, size from data-density. position: fixed at the bottom inline-end corner. In an .ayy-app-shell, place it after __main and before the bottom nav.
classes.ayy-fab--extended: Icon and a visible label: a wider pill ("Compose"). Needs no aria-label.
classes.ayy-fab--secondary: A raised surface with a border instead of the primary fill: less emphasis.
classes.ayy-fab--lg: Larger (the lg control height plus 24px) with a 24px icon, for the one thing a screen is for.
classes.ayy-fab--sm: Smaller (the control-lg size), for a second action stacked above the main one.
classes.ayy-fab--inline: Not floating: in the flow, placed by its container (an empty state, a toolbar, a docs page).

default.looks: Primary: --ayy-color-primary fill, --ayy-color-primary-fg label, semibold. Secondary: wash fill and line border. Outline: transparent with a line-strong border. Ghost: transparent, no border. Destructive: 10% red tint, red label. Link: plain text. Ring: wash inside a gradient ring. Fab: a round primary-colour button with a 20px icon and the lift shadow, fixed to the bottom inline-end corner clear of the home indicator.

hover.looks: Lifts 2px. Primary adds the glow shadow at 90% opacity; secondary, outline, ghost and ring move to wash-hover, wash or highlight with a stronger border; destructive deepens to a 15% tint. Link underlines instead of lifting; ring's border spins. Fab (devices that hover): the fill mixes 12% toward the label colour.

pressed.looks: Drops back to its resting position while held; colours stay as on hover. Fab shrinks to 94%.

focus.looks: 2px --ayy-color-ring outline, 2px offset (3px on a Fab). Ring also spins its border.

disabled.looks: --ayy-opacity-disabled, ignores the pointer. Forced colours: GrayText border and label.

selected.none: Not a toggle. For on/off use a Chip button (aria-pressed), for one of a few a Segmented control, for a setting a Switch.

error.none: Errors belong to the form: a FieldError under the field, or an Alert for a failed action.

loading.when: aria-busy="true" with an aria-hidden .ayy-spinner as the first child (React: loading)
loading.looks: Spinner before the label; clicks and form submits are ignored; stays focusable. Keep the label (or "Saving…") so the width barely moves. Don't spin a Fab: run the action and show progress where its result appears (a new row's Skeleton, a toast).

scale.xs: A step under sm: --ayy-size-control-xs tall (24px compact, 28 comfortable, 36 touch), 12px inline padding less 4px, sm text minus 1px, 14px icon, 4px gap.
scale.sm: Control sm step: --ayy-size-control-sm tall (28px compact, 32 comfortable, 40 touch), --ayy-control-pad-sm inline padding, --ayy-control-text-sm (13/13/14px), --ayy-size-icon-sm (16px) icon, 6px gap.
scale.md: Control md step: --ayy-size-control-md tall (32px compact, 40 comfortable, 44 touch), --ayy-control-pad-md inline padding, --ayy-control-text-md (13/13/14px), --ayy-size-icon-sm (16px) icon, 8px gap.
scale.lg: Control lg step: --ayy-size-control-lg tall (40px compact, 48 comfortable, 52 touch), --ayy-control-pad-lg inline padding, --ayy-control-text-lg (14/15/16px), --ayy-size-icon-md (20px) icon, 8px gap. Matches lg App shell links.
scale.xl: A step over lg: --ayy-size-control-lg plus 8px tall (44px compact, 52 comfortable, 56 touch), lg padding plus 4px, lg text plus 1px, --ayy-size-icon-lg (24px) icon.
scale.icon-xs: Square at the xs height (24/28/36px) with a 14px icon.
scale.icon: Square at the md control height (32/40/44px) with a 16px icon (needs aria-label).
scale.icon-sm: Square at the sm control height (28/32/40px) with a 16px icon.
scale.icon-lg: Square at the lg control height (36/44/48px) with a 20px icon.
scale.icon-xl: Square at the xl height (44/52/56px) with a 24px icon.

sizes.density: Height, inline padding and label size follow data-density across all steps (xs to xl); icons stay fixed at 14px (xs), 16px (sm/md), 20px (lg) and 24px (xl). A Fab's diameter follows data-density through the lg control height: sm 40/48/52px, md 52/60/64px, lg 60/68/72px (compact/comfortable/touch); a data-size scope doesn't resize it, set size on it.
sizes.width: Hugs its label. block (ayy-button--block) fills its container: a phone form, a card footer, a dialog's only action. A Fab is a circle (extended: a pill hugging its icon and label) and takes no room: it floats over the content (inline puts it back in the flow).

js: buttonClass({ variant?, size?, block?, align?, className? }) → string; splitButtonClass({ block?, className? }) → string; fabClass({ variant?, size?, extended?, inline?, className? }) → string, with fabVariants and fabSizes. Loading in HTML: aria-busy="true" plus as the first child.

props.align: "start" | "center" | "end" — where the icon and label sit in a wide button; center is the default.
props.loading: boolean — a Spinner before the label and aria-busy="true"; clicks and form submits are ignored while it's set. Stays focusable.
props.tooltip: ReactNode | boolean — custom tooltip text or element; icon-only buttons show their aria-label on hover by default (pass false to disable).

props.block: boolean — full width (ayy-button-split--block); the main action grows, the menu trigger stays square.

props.extended: boolean — icon and a label; otherwise give it aria-label

a11y: Icon-only buttons need aria-label and should always have a visible Tooltip on hover/focus.
In a SplitButton, give the trailing menu trigger an explicit aria-label naming what it opens ("More deploy options").
Use disabled on <button>; on <a> use aria-disabled="true" (the class handles both).
Visible focus ring on :focus-visible is built in — never remove it.
While it works, set aria-busy="true" and put an aria-hidden .ayy-spinner first inside (React: loading). Don't disable it: focus would jump away.
An icon-only Fab needs an aria-label that says the action ("New task"), not the icon ("Plus").
Put a Fab after the main content in the DOM so it comes after what it acts on in the tab order, not before the page.
A Fab must not cover content for good: the App shell keeps it out of the bottom nav, and lists need room at their end (padding-block-end of the Fab's height) so the last row can scroll clear of it.
do: Use a button for any action the user can take: submit, open, save, delete.
Use a SplitButton when a primary action has closely related alternatives in a DropdownMenu ("Deploy" + "Deploy to preview").
Apply buttonClass() to an <a> when a link should look like an action.
Always pair icon-only buttons (size="icon*", without a text label) with a Tooltip so sighted mouse and keyboard users can identify the action.
Keep one primary button per view or section; make everything else secondary, outline or ghost.
On a marketing or portfolio page, the one call to action can be ring instead of primary, with an outline button beside it.
Put the icon (<Icon> or an .ayy-icon <svg>) before the label; the button sizes it (16px on sm/md, 20px on lg).
Use one Fab for a phone screen's main, constructive action: create, compose, scan, add. Make it extended when the action isn't obvious from an icon, or on the first screens of an app.
Hide the Fab on screens where the main action is already on screen (a form's Save) or while a sheet is open.
dont: Don't use a button for navigation inside running text — use a plain link.
Don't use a button to toggle a setting on/off — use Switch.
Don't restyle colours per button — add a variant to the design system instead.
Don't use destructive for non-destructive emphasis.
Don't use more than one main Fab; stack a small secondary one at most.
Don't put destructive or minor actions (Delete, Share, Settings) in a Fab — use a Top bar action or a Menu.
Don't use a Fab on desktop layouts where a toolbar button fits better.
